message.content: In the conversation, Fionnuala shared a humorous glitch she experienced in Red Dead Redemption 2. She mentioned that one time, she was on a mission, and Arthur ended up floating in mid-air after a cutscene. He just hung there for a solid minute before dropping down like nothing happened! It totally broke the tension of the moment and had her cracking up. This glitch added a unique and unexpected twist to the gameplay, showcasing the unpredictable nature of the game.
